decisions.decision: Keep all calculations and stored numeric values in SI; convert only at GUI, import, export and report boundaries.
decisions.rationale: One calculation basis avoids drift and keeps JSON files independent of the display system.

decisions.decision: Column (x,y) is the reaction/insertion point; the centre is (x+dx, y+dy). Rectangular sections rotate counter-clockwise; wall moments use wall-local axes.
decisions.rationale: Matches ETABS/SAFE insertion-point exports and real wall orientation.

decisions.decision: Evaluate all allowed foundation types per element, reject clashes/outside-site options, rank by preference or cost, and retain alternatives.
decisions.rationale: Gives the engineer a reviewable set of feasible options rather than a single opaque answer.

decisions.decision: Report rigid contact pressure always; use Winkler strips for ordinary rafts and a 16-DOF Kirchhoff plate on Winkler springs for large/custom rafts.
decisions.rationale: Balances speed with a higher-order method where geometry or size demands it.

decisions.decision: Support SPT, static, CPT and direct-report capacity methods; CPT uses qc in MPa and fs in kPa; include downdrag, uplift, Broms lateral and P-M checks.
decisions.rationale: Covers the common soil-report and code workflows without forcing one correlation.

decisions.decision: Accept pre-combined service/factored envelopes, DL/LL/WL/EQ cases, or ETABS/SAFE CSV import; strip numeric coefficients when detecting lateral load cases.
decisions.rationale: Supports both simple and model-based workflows and avoids missing 1.2D+1.6W-style names.

decisions.decision: Produce a ten-sheet Excel workbook, printable PDF, CSV schedule, JSON project and Excel import template; supplemental checks appear in both Excel and PDF.
decisions.rationale: Covers review, hand-off, quantity take-off and reloadable project storage.

decisions.decision: JSON stores SI numeric values and records the display system in info.units.
decisions.rationale: Reloading can restore the user's view without altering engineering values.

decisions.decision: Close all 17 Ponytail audit findings and keep a regression case for every functional fix.
decisions.rationale: Prevents the audited failure modes from silently returning.

decisions.decision: Publish under the MIT license with copyright held by Nandini Shahnewaz; require retention of the copyright and permission notice.
decisions.rationale: Allows free use and commercial adoption while preserving attribution and ownership of the original work.

decisions.decision: Keep a local zip inside the project root, honour .zipignore, include .git history, and exclude virtualenvs, caches, internal skills and nested archives.
decisions.rationale: Provides a complete restorable snapshot without bloating the archive with reproducible environments.

decisions.decision: Maintain the project as a public GitHub repository on main, with samples and .xcontext tracked and generated exports/archives ignored.
decisions.rationale: Keeps the published source complete and reproducible while avoiding large local artifacts.

decisions.decision: Use .xcontext as the durable, interconnected session handoff, with .opencode retained as the detailed historical log.
decisions.rationale: A compact map plus focused records and JSON state makes the next session fast to resume.
